_readme: Topics for PoundMart's national guides (location posts are off). Each 'service' is a topic; paired with an audience and a serviceAngle it gives one article keyword. Audience vars.for adds the audience to keywords that need it (e.g. ' for kids'). 'summary' and 'examples' are treated as true by the writer, so keep them factual. Extra fields: 'category' (one of the blog's four categories: Oral Care, Haircare, Smart Saving, Family & Home) and 'products' (product slugs from lib/products.ts) are written into each post's frontmatter by lib/post-file.ts. excludePairs lists 'topic-id:audience-id' combinations to skip. Check every keyword with npm run seo:generate -- --plan --all.
